# Load Before Continuing

## Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(janitor)
library(vegan)
```

## Loading Data

```{r data loading}
# these chunks of code load in our master spreadsheets for data analysis. kate will keep updating her installed .csv's as we collect more data, but this will allow us to keep code relatively clean and our files relatively clean as well!
inverts_master <- read.csv("invert_master_data.csv")

fish_master <- read.csv("fish_master_data.csv")

upc_master <- read.csv("upc_master_data.csv")

```

## Data Cleaning

```{r scrubby dubby dub in my tubby tubby tub}
# these lines ensure consistent naming conventions so that we don't get caught up in wordslop <3
inverts_master <- clean_names(inverts_master)

fish_master <- clean_names (fish_master) 

upc_master <- clean_names (upc_master)

```

## Data Wrangling

```{r build mcabee data}
# filtering data to each location for site specific analysis
inverts_mcabee <- inverts_master |>
  filter(location == "mcabee") 

fish_mcabee <- fish_master |>
  filter(site_location == "mcabee")

upc_mcabee <- upc_master |>
  filter(location == "mcabee")

```

```{r build morro data}
# filtering data to each location for site specific analysis (Morro Bay Edition)
inverts_morro <- inverts_master |>
  filter(location == "target_rock") 

fish_morro <- fish_master |>
  filter(site_location == "target_rock")

upc_morro <- upc_master |>
  filter(location == "target_rock")

```

# Shannon Diversity

```{r shannon setup}
# organizing the data into total observations per species to run Shannon Index off of

# Monterey Bay

# fish
shannon_fish_mcabee <- fish_mcabee |>
  select("species", "count") |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarize(total_count = sum(count))

# invert
shannon_inverts_mcabee <- inverts_mcabee |>
  select("species", "count") |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarize(total_count = sum(count))


# Morro Bay

# fish
shannon_fish_morro <- fish_morro |>
  select("species", "count") |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarize(total_count = sum(count))

# invert
shannon_inverts_morro <- inverts_morro |>
  select("species", "count") |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarize(total_count = sum(count))


# Leo Carrillo

# fish
shannon_fish_leo <- fish_leo |>
  select("species", "count") |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarize(total_count = sum(count))

# invert
shannon_inverts_leo <- inverts_leo |>
  select("species", "count") |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarize(total_count = sum(count))


# La Jolla

# fish
shannon_fish_jolla <- fish_jolla |>
  select("species", "count") |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarize(total_count = sum(count))

# invert
shannon_inverts_jolla <- inverts_jolla |>
  select("species", "count") |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarize(total_count = sum(count))

# names have been preemptively entered into the data, so check for conflicting names if any errors occur
```

```{r shannon knock them down}
# shannon diversity calculations and table output

# Monterey Bay

# fish
mont_f <- diversity(shannon_fish_mcabee$total_count)

# invert
mont_i <- diversity(shannon_inverts_mcabee$total_count)

# Morro Bay

# fish
morr_f <- diversity(shannon_fish_morro$total_count)

# invert
morr_i <- diversity(shannon_inverts_morro$total_count)

# Leo Carrillo

# fish
leo_f <- diversity(shannon_fish_leo$total_count)

# invert
leo_i <- diversity(shannon_inverts_leo$total_count)

# La Jolla

# fish
joll_f <- diversity(shannon_fish_jolla$total_count)

# invert
joll_i <-diversity(shannon_inverts_jolla$total_count)


# fish diversity index table creation
tibble("Monterey Diversity" = mont_f, 
       "Morro Bay Diversity" = morr_f, 
       "Leo Carrillo Diveristy" = leo_f, 
       "La Jolla Diversity" = joll_f)

# invert diversity index table creation
tibble("Monterey Diversity" = mont_i, 
       "Morro Bay Diversity" = morr_i, 
       "Leo Carrillo Diveristy" = leo_i, 
       "La Jolla Diversity" = joll_i)

# again, names could be a potential issue for running code in this chunk
```

# Visuals
```{r ocean's visual 1}
mcabee_density <- inverts_mcabee %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(density = sum(total_count, na.rm = TRUE) / 100)

ggplot(mcabee_density,
       aes(x = reorder(species, -density), y = density,
       fill = species)) +
  geom_col() +
labs(title = "Density of McAbee Invertebrate Species 2026",
    x = "Species", y = "Density per Meter Squared") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.35, "cm"),
    legend.key.width = unit(0.35, "cm")
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2))
```

```{r Mateos Visual 1}
morro_fish_density <- fish_master |>
  filter(site_location == "target_rock") |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarise(
    density = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE) / 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(density))

ggplot(morro_fish_density,
       aes(x = reorder(species, -density),
           y = density,
           fill = species)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Density of Morro Bay Fish Species 2026",
    x = "Species",
    y = "Density per Meter Squared",
    fill = "Species"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.35, "cm"),
    legend.key.width = unit(0.35, "cm")
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2))
```

